MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The EnviroCare bags match the Panasonic U, U-3 and U-6 types I recently bought, so they fit a specific replacement need.",
    "The smaller pack is still relevant because it preserves the bag compatibility that matters to me."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Oreck bags serve the same purpose as my recent vacuum bags but fit different equipment, so I would not choose them.",
    "The brad and staple assortment does not match the framing nails I selected; the tool requirements and intended jobs matter more than both being nails.",
    "Tapes, steel wool, spray bottles, cleaner and a storage basket suggest tasks I have not shown a current need to do."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of screws and anchors seem to have been treated as interest in general repair and workshop supplies.",
    "My vacuum-bag purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in other vacuum brands and unrelated cleaning supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact equipment compatibility matters: Panasonic bag types are useful to me, while Oreck bags are not interchangeable.",
    "My framing-nail choices include specific lengths, diameters and collation types, which matter when deciding whether another fastener is suitable.",
    "I choose supplies for a concrete current task; a nearby use or general household usefulness is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my replacement-bag need but otherwise inferred broad repair and cleaning interests from purchases with much more specific uses."
}
